whoAmI.title: Who Am I ?
whoAmI.content2: Since my childhood, I've been fascinated by the world of video games, a passion that sparked my interest in development. I then began my studies in the field of web development to understand development in general, and obtained a Bachelor's degree in Multimedia and Internet Jobs, thus laying a solid foundation for my career.
whoAmI.content3: Currently, I am a student at the IIM Digital School in Paris, focusing on the video game axis, in order to leverage my technical skills and passion for this field that I am so passionate about.
whoAmI.content4: Always eager to broaden my skillset, I approach each challenge with enthusiasm and a commitment to continuous improvement.

tesimonials.name: Julien Chamayou
tesimonials.comment:
I had the opportunity to supervise Noam during his internship within a web application development project at Sopra Steria. Noam is committed, personable, and proactive. 
 He integrated very well into the team and effectively improved his skills over time on a technical stack he was not familiar with (Java, Spring, VueJS) in order to deliver high-quality outcomes, always adhering to the team's processes.

tesimonials.name: Emilien Regent
tesimonials.comment: Noam has shown a real aptitude for the Unity engine. He quickly gained proficiency in the topics covered in class (engine foundation, 3Cs) and didn't hesitate to delve into other concepts on his own (scriptable objects, cinemachine).

tesimonials.name: Amel Chabah
tesimonials.work: UX/UI Designer & Full-Stack Developer at GAEL Systems
tesimonials.comment:
Noam is an exceptional collaborator whose bright personality and remarkable skills have left a mark on every project we have shared. Endowed with natural charisma and innate leadership qualities, he inspires everyone to give their best. 
 A born educator, he motivates and guides his team with uncommon ease. His ease with public speaking and relentless commitment make him a true asset to all his projects. 
 Always in pursuit of perfection, Noam embraces challenges with enthusiasm, bringing positive energy to every situation. Working alongside him is a real pleasure, and I am convinced that he will continue to shine and be a source of inspiration for all his future projects.
